title: The sum-of-digits function of polynomial sequences
relevant_concepts: sum of digits of polynomial values
notes: Ordinary s_q(P(n)) along polynomial sequences, in the Gelfond line (squares treated earlier by Mauduit–Rivat). Residue-class distribution, not the exact level set s_q(P(n))=0 and not the signed balanced translation s_3(2|P(n)|)=s_3(|P(n)|).
